# Frontmatter Edge Cases

This document tests content that might appear near the top of a document.

## Section with Colons

Key: value pairs appear in configuration files.

Status: active and running.

## Section with Special Characters

Ampersands and angle brackets are common in text.

Quotes like "double" and 'single' are used frequently.

## Section with Booleans in Text

The values true and false are often used in configuration.

Yes and no are common responses.

## Mixed Content Types

> A blockquote with a colon: this is the quote content.

- Item with colon: description here
- Another item: more description

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| name | Test Document |
| version | 1.0.0 |
| enabled | true |
